annotations.title: Where to stay: hotels, inns, motels and campsites

description: Verified East End places to stay: hotels, inns, motels, B&Bs, resorts and campsites, each with the operator's own booking page (`bookDirect`), phone, address and the date the guide last read that source. `query` matches the fields the guide keeps, not only names: 'pet friendly', 'pool', 'beachfront', 'camping', 'family', 'walk to town' and 'year-round' all resolve. Each row carries `season`, whether the property is year-round or the months it operates. `amenitiesUnknown` counts lodgings in scope with no amenity list on file, so an amenity query is answered over the lodgings that have one. `editorialNote` marks records confirmed to exist by a Google Places sweep that no editor has described, and `awaitingEditorialPass` counts them. `priceTier` appears only where an editor assigned one and is a coarse band; the guide holds no rates, no availability and no room types. `closed` is returned when `query` names a lodging on record as shut. `rentalNeighborhoods` is the guide's note on which part of a hamlet to rent in. With neither argument nothing is looked up and the answer lists the towns covered. Returns up to 8. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'pet friendly', 'pool', 'beachfront', 'camping', 'B&B', or a property name.

town.description: A hamlet ('Montauk', 'Greenport') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words.
